purpose: W card with ON after the model: ngspice accepts the word (cswparam.c:24-31), but it never reaches the .op inside a positive band. At INITFLOAT, cswload.c:65-71 takes CKTstate1, which no .op iteration writes (0 = REALLY_OFF), not the state0 the flag seeded at :39-56. So mid starts off for ON, OFF and none alike. neg (ih=-0.2m) and zero (ih=0, control at it) start on (:72-88). SpiceRack P8-045: ESPice started neg and zero off.

oracle.derivation: Stock ngspice-44.2 batch run of this deck, binary raw, columns by name; stock ngspice-45 writes the same bytes for every column. Analytic check: each output is 1 V divided between 1k and the switch, on = 1/1001 V (ron=1) and off = 1meg/1.001meg V (roff=1meg); ngspice is within 1 ulp of both. On and off differ by 1000x, so rtol 1e-9 sees any wrong state.
